parent_objective: design sequence-level temporal intervention probe over M1236 normal-surviving rows
blocked_by: M1236 repairs normal survival but single cross-fault hidden swaps remain history-insensitive
supersedes: more single hidden-swap tuning on M1236
invalidates: training from M1236 because normal survival alone is not self-ID evidence

public_gates: M1237 may design sequence intervention only
M1237 must preserve actor input contract
M1237 must not use private holdout
M1237 must distinguish cross-fault sequence evidence from temporal/reset variants
M1237 must select a bounded first implementation step
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden fault labels or hidden parameters to actor inputs
do not count normal-survival repair as self-ID evidence
do not count reset-only rows as wrong-history positives
do not claim true per-wheel or asymmetric fault physics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: moves from single hidden-state swaps to sequence-level command-response interventions after M1236 repaired normal survival but found no hidden-swap signal
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if sequence source rows cannot be filtered from normal-surviving M1236 rows
stop if the probe would require hidden labels as actor inputs
stop if cross-fault, temporal, reset, and action-only outcomes are not separated
fallback_plan: if M1236 rows cannot drive the existing probe, create a small source-row adapter first
if sequence interventions produce only action-only rows, route to terminal-margin-grounded sequence target redesign
if sequence interventions are normal-failed, return to timing repair
if source-diverse sequence outcomes appear, route to corpus export and exact objective sanity
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1236 passes normal-survival repair and routes to sequence-level intervention

admission_evidence: M1236 has zero wrong-history and zero reset-hidden action-critical rows
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1237 is sequence-intervention design and does not yet test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design future delayed, cross-fault, command-response mismatch, zero-command, and reset-then-warm sequence variants
require future results to separate cross-fault sequence positives from temporal/reset/action-only positives
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Self-ID evidence remains blocked until a future source-diverse sequence outcome gate passes and is audited.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If sequence interventions remain no-signal or action-only, record the negative and synthesize the branch rather than training.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1236 normal-surviving but history-insensitive rows are better tested by sequence-level command-response interventions than by further single hidden-state swaps.
success_criteria: first bounded probe command is specified
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design depends on hidden labels as actor inputs
normal-surviving rows are treated as self-ID evidence
decision_rule: M1237 passes if it defines a bounded sequence-level intervention route over M1236 normal-surviving rows with actor-input guardrails and explicit result taxonomy.
